1479-2841-3897-6528.description:

Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.

Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elfsworn Giant from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Elfsworn Giant triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

2178-4147-4215-8095.easyPrerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Hua Tuo.

During your precombat main phase, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the additional nontoken green creature.

Holding priority, activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Hua Tuo trigger from step 2, untapping it.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for the sacrificed creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.

Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the Vehicle.
When the Vehicle dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning the Vehicle from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not be an Angel because the Vehicle is no longer a creature and cannot gain creature types.
When the Vehicle enters the battlefield, Simulacrum Synthesizer triggers, creating a 0/0 Construct artifact creature token that gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat from step 3.

Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.

2034-3129-3209.notes: The starting cost can be reduced by tapping creatures to pay for Sprout Swarm using its convoke ability, and/or sacrificing those creatures to Ashnod's Altar.

Activate Covert Technician's ninjutsu ability by paying {1}{U} and returning Great Whale from the battlefield to your hand, putting Covert Technician onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.

Activate Samwise by sacrificing Syr Ginger and the two Foods, returning Gingerbrute to your hand from the battlefield.

Once you have drawn your library, you may cast Ugin's Conjurant with X equaling the amount of life you gained this turn to have it enter the battlefield with a large amount of +1/+1 counters, and to gain that much life due to Bounteous Kirin.

Kederekt Parasite triggers for each card your opponent draw this way, giving each opponent seven poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters.

1811-2067-2542.notablePrerequisites:

Resolve the Zada trigger, copying the spell for each other creature you control, with each copy targeting a different creature.
Venerated Rotpriest triggers for each copy made this way.
Resolve the first trigger, causing an opponent to get a poison counter.
If the opponent has ten poison counters, they lose the game.
Repeat from step 7 for each remaining trigger.

Activate Gemstone Array's second ability by removing a charge counter from it, adding {B}.

Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, returning the creature to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia trigger, milling the targeted player.

1613-2050-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Arbor Elf.

1613-2050-4222.description:

Resolve Shrieking Drake's trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
